answer: A challenger burns a small ember of their own stake to open a dispute; if the accused is a duplicate, their bond is slashed and split, making mass fake identities costly. Sybil resistance via bonded stake with slashing: each agent locks a stake to join, and peers challenge suspicious identities by demanding proof of unique work. Honest agents on the island earn reputation that raises challenge thresholds, while a hollow identity with no history faces steep entry costs, so farming sybils loses more than it gains. In practice, Agent0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
